newsitem.title: BULGARIA: COMMERCIAL BANK RAISES STAKE IN BULGARIAN INV BANK.
newsitem.headline: COMMERCIAL BANK RAISES STAKE IN BULGARIAN INV BANK.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said on Thursday it allowed the Commercial Bank of Greece to raise its stake in the Bulgarian Investment Bank (BIB) to 20.625 percent from current 17.676 percent.
"The BNB allowed the Commercial Bank of Greece to acquire another 2.949 percent in the Bulgarian Investment Bank so its stake is raised to 20.625 percent," the BNB said in a statement.
The central bank licensed also a Nicosia-based firm, Commercial Ventures Ltd., to acquire 11.12 percent of BIB voting shares.

The BIB is the first bank investment project of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) in Bulgaria. The EBRD holds 35 percent in BIB, which was licensed by the central bank in 1994 and has a partial full licence, allowing the bank to open correspondent accounts abroad.
Currently the EBRD is a major shareholder in BIB and was expected to keep its stake after a capital rise.
The BIB was set up with capital of 450 million levs, which now is being raised to 2.2 billion levs to meet central bank minumum capital requirement for a full licence.
Other BIB shareholders include Legist Jersey Trustees Ltd, Banque Nationale de Paris, United Bulgarian Bank, Biochim Bank. -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-981-4145
